def _fastforward(name: str, statistics: Dict[str, Dict[str, str]]) ->Tuple[
    str, Dict[str, str]]:
    """
    If the given module has only a single child in statistics, and the
    statistics of the module and child can be combined (i.e. they don't
    conflict), fast-forward to the child. Repeat until we can't fast-forward
    anymore.

    Returns the name and statistics of the final module after fast-forwarding.
    """
    curr_stats = statistics.get(name, {})
    
    while True:
        child = _get_single_child(name, statistics)
        if child is None:
            break
        child_stats = statistics.get(child, {})
        combined = _try_combine(curr_stats, child_stats)
        if combined is None:
            break
        name = child
        curr_stats = combined
    
    return name, curr_stats
